messages:
Nora: Quick sync — planning a small PLG funnel experiment that bundles starter credits + a curated prompt template pack and a webinar invite for new signups. Goal: lift 7-day activation rate by +15%.
Evan: Nice. What counts as activation here? :thinking_face:
Nora: Activation = first meaningful generation (>=10 tokens) or first embed call within 7 days. We'll A/B test vs baseline onboarding.
Priya: Can we segment by signup source? webinar RSVPs vs organic? I think conversion path differs.
Gabe: Proposed rollout (quick):
- Control: current onboarding flow
- Variant A: +$15 starter credits, prompt pack (3 templates), onboarding email w/ webinar CTA
- Variant B: same as A + in-console prompt suggestions carousel
We'll run for n=3k new signups or 2 weeks.
Evan: Tracking hooks?
Nora: UTM + experiment tag: utm_experiment=onboard_prompt_slate. Event names: experiment_assigned, credits_redeemed, first_generation. Want funnel per-source.
Priya: Also add a small evaluation set to monitor hallucination/quality on the prompt pack. If QA drops, rollback.
Gabe: I’ll draft the experiment config. Sample payload for assignment:
```
{
  "experiment": "onboard_prompt_slate",
  "variant": "A",
  "credits": 15,
  "prompt_pack": "starter-templates-v1",
  "cta": "webinar-rsvp"
}
```
Priya: Love that. Who owns copy + webinar landing?
Nora: @Evan you own the landing + launch post draft. @Priya owns the prompt pack QA. @Gabe you own instrumentation/config. I’ll coordinate the webinar schedule with ops.
Evan: On it. Draft landing + short launch post by EOD tomorrow. Will ping design for 1 hero image :paintbrush:
Gabe: Instrumentation checklist:
- feature flag gate for rollout
- analytics events + props (variant, source, credit_amount)
- attribution window 7 days
- dashboard widget for daily activation and cost-per-activation
I’ll create the FF and post link here when ready.
onboarding-bot: Experiment created: EX-4321 (onboard_prompt_slate), feature-flag: ff/onboard_prompt_slate
Priya: For prompt pack QA: I’ll run 100 prompts across top 3 models, record quality and token cost. If quality drop >5% vs baseline, we hold.
Nora: Two quick asks for the group:
1) Evan: landing + 2 social launch post variants (short + long)
2) Gabe: FF + dashboard by Tues
3) Priya: QA report and rollout pass
If everyone is green we aim to flip 5% traffic on Wed and ramp.
Evan: Green — will post drafts in #marketing-drafts and tag you.
Gabe: FF created: https://ff.redwood/flags/onboard_prompt_slate — will link dashboard prototype later.
Nora: Awesome. Thanks team! :rocket:
